title: Exact approval tab readiness
summary: Linux waits for the exact request URL or its canonical same-code organization route before approving; older tabs do not establish readiness. Linux and Safari report machine_browser_sign_in_required for missing approval tabs when same-origin tabs show /auth/sign-in, /beta or /orgs/new. Evidence records paths with codes redacted and queries/fragments omitted. Recovery asks the operator to sign the Test Machine browser in and recapture golden; it grants no agent authority. Absent and foreign-origin tabs retain machine_browser_tab_missing. Host preparation refusals remain unchanged.
